categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the manufacturing and sales of superhard cutting tools, superhard materials, and cemented carbide cutting tools. It also develops diamond functional materials including CVD diamond acoustic devices, heat sinks, optical windows, and boron-doped diamond electrodes. The business is organized into three main divisions: precision cutting tools, 3C tools, and semiconductor tools and materials.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies such as CVD diamond growth, vacuum brazing, laser micro-nano precision processing, ultra-thin diamond grinding and polishing, and automated equipment manufacturing. It has proprietary technologies in superhard material laser processing, vacuum application, and diamond functional material growth. The production process includes strict quality control and uses high-precision inspection equipment.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include manufacturers in the consumer electronics, automotive (especially new energy vehicles), aerospace, wind power, nuclear power, rail transit, general machinery, engineering machinery, and semiconductor industries. The company serves global high-end tool markets and provides integrated cutting solutions to well-known international and domestic clients.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Hebei, Zhejiang, and Guangdong provinces, covering major economic regions such as Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, Yangtze River Delta, and Pearl River Delta. It has established subsidiaries and offices in Europe (Germany), Singapore, and Mexico, actively expanding its international market presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and supplying high-end cutting tools and diamond functional materials to industrial manufacturers. It also engages in R&D and provides integrated solutions, positioning itself as a comprehensive tool solution provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening core business focus on superhard tools, expanding diamond functional materials as a second growth curve, and accelerating global market expansion. R&D efforts emphasize new product development in micro-drills, diamond coatings, acoustic membranes, and large-size single/multi-crystal diamonds. The company invests heavily in innovation platforms and patent development to maintain technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of superhard cutting tools, cemented carbide tools, and diamond functional materials. The company employs a combination of direct sales, OEM/ODM sales, and distribution channels to reach end customers. It also provides processing services and customized tool solutions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic integrated cutting tool solution provider competing with international giants like Sandvik, Kennametal, and Iscar in the high-end tool market. It holds a strong position in China with growing international recognition and is advancing in the high-precision and superhard tool segments.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 678.5 million, a 12.54% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 99.2 million, up 1.85%. It maintains steady growth with increasing cash flow from operations and continuous R&D investment accounting for over 7% of revenue. Total assets reached RMB 2.27 billion, reflecting expansion and capital investment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high precision, durability, and customization in its superhard and carbide cutting tools, offering integrated cutting solutions tailored to customer needs. Its mastery of full-process CVD diamond growth technology and proprietary functional diamond materials provide competitive advantages in performance and application breadth. The company also highlights rapid innovation, strong customer service, and global supply capabilities as key differentiators.
